titre: Confirmer qui est vraiment l'acheteur avec cinq questions par profil
description: Après un title sweep, Jev relit le profil complet de chaque personne retenue et répond à cinq questions fermées d'un coup : elle tient le problème, elle peut signer, elle utiliserait le service au quotidien, son poste actuel confirme l'intitulé stocké, elle appartient à un service exclu. La liste à appeler regroupe les profils qui tiennent le problème, peuvent signer, sont confirmés en poste et n'appartiennent pas à un service exclu ; la question sur l'usage quotidien donne la seconde liste, celle des utilisateurs à associer. C'est la troisième lecture de Jordan Crawford (Blueprint GTM) : 1 084 personnes acceptées par cinq questions sur un compte de 79 601. Les règles d'achat sont un exemple (un cabinet de prospection externalisée pour PME B2B) : à réécrire pour votre offre.

instructions.buying_rules: We sell outsourced outbound prospecting (booked meetings) to French B2B SMEs. The problem owner answers for new business revenue: founder or CEO of a company under 250 people, Directeur commercial, Head of Sales, CRO, VP Sales, or a business unit or agency director with a revenue target. Daily users take the booked meetings: account executives, sales reps, business developers, SDRs, sales ops. Finance, accounting, legal, HR, IT and procurement are excluded.
instructions.question: Given `buying_rules`, does this person own the problem we solve, judging from `job_title`, `linkedin_headline`, `about` and `poste_actuel`?

criteria.true: The person answers for new business revenue or the sales pipeline: founder, CEO, Président, Directeur général of an SME, Directeur commercial, Head of Sales, CRO, VP Sales, Directeur du développement, an agency or business unit director with a revenue target, or a marketing lead explicitly in charge of lead generation.
criteria.false: The person works in another function (product, operations, finance, HR, engineering, support, legal, claims) or executes sales without owning the target (sales rep, SDR, account manager, chargé de clientèle).

peut_signer.instructions: Can this person sign or sponsor the purchase of an outsourced prospecting service, judging from the level shown in `job_title`, `linkedin_headline` and `poste_actuel`?

criteria.true: Founder, co-founder, owner, CEO, Président, Directeur général, any C-level, VP, Directeur, Head of, Managing Partner, Associé, or a site, agency or business unit director.
criteria.false: Responsable or manager without a department budget, team lead, individual contributor, consultant, assistant, intern, or a level that cannot be read from the text.

instructions.question: Given `buying_rules`, would this person use the service day to day (take the booked meetings, work the leads), judging from the whole profile?

criteria.true: Account executive, sales rep, commercial, business developer, SDR, BDR, ingénieur d'affaires, key account manager, sales ops, or a founder or sales director whose `about` says they still sell or follow clients personally.
criteria.false: A role that never takes a sales meeting: finance, HR, legal, IT, product, engineering, support, claims, marketing without a sales duty, or an executive whose text shows no personal selling.

poste_confirme.instructions: Does `poste_actuel` (the current position on the LinkedIn profile) confirm that this person holds `job_title` at `entreprise_cible` today? A different employer, a role listed only in `postes_passes`, an end date, or a headline announcing a new job elsewhere means no.

criteria.true: The current position names `entreprise_cible` (or its brand) and a role equivalent to `job_title`, with no end date.
criteria.false: The current position is at another company, the role at `entreprise_cible` appears only among past positions or carries an end date, or the headline says 'ex-', 'freelance', 'open to work' or names a new employer.
